caption: The drawing depicts five distinct circular or oval objects arranged in a loose pentagonal composition on a plain, light beige background. At the top left, there is an oval object featuring a brownish inner area outlined in yellowish gold. To its right at the top, there is another small circular object with a white interior containing a finely detailed portrait, and it is also encircled by a thin gold border. In the central area, there is a larger circular object with a pink center surrounded by a border of dark, rounded shapes, with a central cluster of small dark dots or gems. At the lower left is another circular object with a bright turquoise blue center, encircled by a textured or patterned gold rim. At the lower right, there is a circular object with a brown center, featuring a design of a branch with two leaves and a small flower rendered in white and black, bordered by a dark, open lattice pattern. The background is unadorned, and the objects are evenly spaced apart, each rendered with fine details and outlined clearly.
title: Buttons
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
